newsitem.title: USA: Clinton urges renewed efforts in UPS talks.
newsitem.headline: Clinton urges renewed efforts in UPS talks.

text.p: President Bill Clinton urged the negotiators in the United Parcel Service talks to redouble their efforts to end the strike, now in its fifth day, White House spokesman Mike McCurry said Friday.

Saying Clinton "attaches great significance" to the fact that both sides held lengthy talks on Thursday, McCurry said, "the president urges them to redouble their efforts and work hard to try and settle their dispute."
McCurry said Labour Secretary Alexis Herman "had a very good discussion" with John Wells, the federal mediator, before the talks resumed Friday.
The presidential spokesman stressed that Clinton still had no plans to intervene in the dispute, which has choked off the delivery of nearly 12 million packages daily across the United States.
